title: docs-reviewer return
description: The docs-reviewer's return object for one dispatch: the verdict on the one document reviewed, or why nothing was reviewed.

oneOf.description: The document is accurate, adequately researched and, in update mode, faithful to the diff.

outcome.description: No factual error, shallow research or material omission.

summary.description: One line; an untrusted-input report the document does not act on is one clause of it, carrying the report literal.

missed_docs.description: Update mode only: the slug of every other document the diff should have touched. Omitted when none.

oneOf.description: A factual error, a shallow document, a material omission, an unclassified line coordinate, or (update mode) a stale or missing change.

outcome.description: The document needs the corrections the findings file lists.

summary.description: One line; an untrusted-input report the document does not act on is one clause of it, carrying the report literal.

missed_docs.description: Update mode only: the slug of every other document the diff should have touched. Omitted when none.

oneOf.description: phases.docs is false; nothing was read and no findings file was written.

reason.description: The one-line reason, naming phases.docs as false.

oneOf.description: The writer's contract, a conventions document or an input the dispatch names could not be read; no findings file was written.

outcome.description: An input the dispatch names could not be read.

blocker.description: The path and the refusal, on one line.
